claim_boundary: Official LongMemEval-V2 small-tier dataset, deterministic graders, and LLM-grader prompts with GPT-6 Astra as a fixed OpenCode/ChatGPT-OAuth answer reader and GPT-5.5 OAuth as a separate judge. Engram OFF/ON uses the same reader, questions, order and concurrency; only the memory method changes. RAG is a secondary comparator. The custom OAuth transports and judge model make this a separate frontier-reader replication, not an official leaderboard submission.

runtime_target.basis: Astra concurrency-2 smokes, local index/retrieval timings, and a 9.84-second GPT-5.5 OAuth grader smoke; account throttling can extend wall time.
